cause_quote: The live preview introduction caught renderer download failures with `this.previewError = formatUiError(error);` and displayed the resulting text with `t("dashboardDocument.loadFailed", { error: this.error })` inside the clipped preview.
user_saw: When the dashboard preview renderer failed to download, the card showed a technical file URL and told users to check the Gateway, with the last line cut off at larger text sizes.
summary: The fix shows concise, localized reload guidance when a dashboard preview fails to download its renderer chunk.
reasoning: The introducing diff replaced decorative placeholders with live previews and immediately rendered formatted download errors in a fixed-aspect card with hidden overflow. I checked the later Solid migration and its parent, which showed that the migration moved the existing error handling into a component boundary and preserved the same generic message.
